senses.gloss:
Kailāsakāraka
med. Śiva-Pārvatī-saṁvāda. MD. 13113. 15449 (Rasotpatti ch.). MT. 5730 (inc.). Trav. Uni. T. 1442 (inc.). Triv. Cur. II. 85 (till end of Bījalakṣaṇa).

Kailāsakhaṇḍa
from Śivapurāṇa. AS. p. 201.
See Kailāsasaṁhitā.

Kailāsanātha_(?)
uncle of Padmanābha (a. of Śarvāṇīstava, Trav. Uni. 3292P).

Kailāsanātha
of Kāśyapa gotra, an. Penugoṇḍa family; son of Timmayajvan an. eldest paternal uncle of Someśvara (a. of Saṁśayoddhāra or Sarvasmṛtiº, MT. 1938 (c)).

Kailāsanātha
--Manoharakāvyamālā (compiled).
Pt.. Lahore, 1929. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p.. 1208. 1573.

Kailāsaparvatavarṇanaprabandha
Harihara Sastri XIV. 6.
See Kailāsavarṇana. [Page076-b]

Kailāsaparvatastotra
Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 20.

Kailāsamāhātmya
from Śivapurāṇa. Mandlik p. 66, BH. 25 (ii).

Kailāsamāhātmya
or Māyāpurī Māhātmya from Skāndapurāṇa, Kedārakhaṇḍa. NS. Press 259.

Kailāsa_Yati
--Traivarṇikasaṁnyāsa. Oudh XI. 38.

Kailāsayātrā
paur. Mithilā. Pheh. 5. Trippūṇittura II. 194 (2).
--from Harivaṁśa, Bhaviṣyaparva. chs. 73-90. Adyar I. p. 134a. Bikaner 1007. CPB. 1062. Lz. 184 (inc.). Poona II. 88. Trav. Uni. 689.
Pt.. Harivaṁśa, Veṅk. Press, p.. 105-120.

Kailāsavarṇana
in prose by Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa. GD. 1622A. 1658E. Granthappura p.. 80, no. 1622 (a.. 82, no. 1658 (c). Harihara Sastri XIV. 6 (Kai. parvatavarṇana). TCD. 1381J. Trav. Uni. 89C. T. M. 262J.
Pt.. in Malayalam script. See Contribution of Kerala to Skt. Lit. p. 146.

Kailāsavilāsa
Q. in Sujana's Śabdaliṅgārthacandrikā (Adyar ms.).
See Adyar Library Bulletin VII. i. 1943, p. 41.

Kailāsasaṃhitā
identity not known. Bik. 1671. Oudh V. 2.
--from Ādityapurāṇa. Sūcīpattra 72.

Kailāsasaṃhitā
one of the 12 books of Śivapurāṇa (Veṅk. Press edn. p.. 382-404). AS. p. 201 (K. khaṇḍa). Ben. 52 (Uttarārdha). NP. VIII. 20. IX. 20. X. 22. RASB. V. 3540 (23 chs.). Stein 215 (Uttarārdha, chs. 31-42).
See also under Śivapurāṇa. [Page077-a.

Kailāsasaṃhitā
on Bhakti. Q. in Raghunāthendra Yati's Bhagavannāma-māhātmyasaṅgraha, Princess of Wales Sar. Bha. Texts 56, p. 140.

Kailāsasāmudrī
jy. by Mahendrācārya. Oudh XVII. 34.

Kailāsācalayati
or kailAsAcArya preceptor of Kṛṣṇānanda (a. of Kaulagajamardana, Oudh IX. 18. RASB. VIII. A. 6447. Composed in 1854 A. D.).

Kailāseśastotra
Taylor II. 211 (inc.).

Kailāsoddharaṇa
Q. in Durghaṭavṛtti of Śaraṇadeva (p. 62. TSS. 6).
